name: Three-View Projection
description: Build orthographic view questions from marked cube stacks and newly authored STEP solids with FreeCAD and TechDraw.
steps: Select a pattern and inspect its representative original
Record the intended inference, condition, closest foil and distinguishing evidence
Construct the object and render its views in FreeCAD
Compose the question and derive its answer independently
Check the declared inference and revise the named option or condition if needed
Review the final image and publish the verified task
